Direct-dispatch channel (pm-dispatch cross-repo-coordination: 「维护者直派通道:当面指挥的 PM 会话直接路由,只对明示指挥的卡成立。直派的审计评论逐字引用授权指令。」). The authorising words, verbatim and untranslated — the maintainer, 2026-10-23, replying to the director seat's offer:

> seat: (a) 我按 PM 流程把 A1–A5、B1–B3 立成卡进队列(英文卡面、带 Governing text: 与工作量列),由 os-dev 派发;(b) 先只要这份报告,总监席决裁批照原计划开。
> maintainer: 同意，立卡

The word covers filing and dispatch; the lane seat dispatches this card under it even while a p1 sits in the lane queue (优先序:维护者裁决 > 北极星). Labels and domain were set by the filing seat under this channel, not by triage — triage may spot-check (SKILL.md 域车道 例外二).

Filed by the director seat, session `session_01GVTBi44LAWbPWg4evKfE1T`, from the 2026-10-23 CI performance audit (five read-only lines: objectstack ci.yml + lint.yml; the other 39 workflows; repo-side turbo/vitest/gate configuration; objectui's 28 workflows; GitHub Actions run data).

ACCEPT → PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13028 comment 6364330747 (终局四件套: 9868 lines > 3000; `needs-user-decision` on the PR; waits for an authorized approval, then the seat queues it) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · 2026-10-23T11:58Z

Ruling recorded · card session `session_01Cr2pnminvpXPZAG6sKgzgN` · 2026-10-23T12:07Z

Step 2 of this card offered two routes; both were measured unworkable as written (2026-10-23, objectui `main` `2c4e5f5`):

- the `workflow_dispatch` route rests on a premise that does not hold: `ci.yml`'s `on:` is `push` / `pull_request` / `merge_group` / `schedule` only, and six of the queue's seven required contexts (`Lint` aside) come from workflows that take no `workflow_dispatch` (`ci.yml`'s `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Test`; `changeset-presence.yml`'s `Changeset Declaration`; `governed-surface-guard.yml`'s `Governed Surface Queue Guard`);
- the relay route has no caller: the objectstack fleet-write relay starts only on a `repository_dispatch` to objectstack, which this repository's `GITHUB_TOKEN` cannot send, and no workflow here holds an App credential.

Step 1 is done: the relay's `pr_update_branch` synced objectstack-ai/objectui#13028 as the fleet (head `17b3796`), every required context went green, and the seat's record is on objectstack-ai/objectui#13028.

**Ruled: the refresh mints a narrowed, short-lived fleet App token on its runner (`actions/create-github-app-token`, the organization's `OS_FLEET_APP_ID` variable and `OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY` secret, scoped to this one repository) and pushes its branch and opens or updates its pull request with it, so the pull request's own events start CI.**

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): Sales (`os-sales`), the project owner directing this lane, in the project chat on 2026-10-23, replying to the coordinator's two-option summary (the App-token route vs. an objectstack-side upstream route with this card parked). Verbatim reply, untranslated:

> A

Two things this ruling cannot settle, asked of the maintainers (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) here; the implementing pull request stays a draft and waits for them:

1. **Secret visibility.** Is the organization secret `OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY` (and variable `OS_FLEET_APP_ID`) visible to `objectstack-ai/objectui`? A session cannot read an organization secret's repository access. If it is restricted to selected repositories, adding objectui is the one settings action this needs.
2. **Narrowing objectui#5397.** That ruling (2026-08-22) rejected "a PAT / GitHub App token" for the release pull request because a zero-trust-surface alternative existed there (validate the post-version tree in-workflow). This card has no such alternative: the refresh pull request exists so the new split runs the full suite before it lands. Confirm that objectstack-ai/objectui#5397's rejection is read as scoped to the release pull request, so this workflow may mint the fleet token. A personal access token stays out either way.

Approving the implementing pull request answers both.

**Why.** The project owner has decided to merge objectui into the objectstack repository. This card changes objectui's own CI: the weekly shard-timings refresh workflow and its PR, objectstack-ai/objectui#13028. So the card stops here rather than finish a route that the move will replace.

**Provenance.** The instruction is Sales's (the project owner, account `os-sales`). Their words were 「按建议」 ("as proposed"), given in this project's chat at 2026-10-24T13:15Z. It approves the coordinator's plan for the ui lane during the repo move, and that plan names this card as stopped.

**State left behind:**
- Step 2 is merged as PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13362. The refresh workflow mints a fleet App token.
- Step 1, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13028, is open and awaits maintainer approval. It is not closed, because the scheduled refresh force-pushes its branch, and a maintainer may still land it.
- The acceptance readings this card was waiting for are not taken: Monday 10-26's refresh PR getting its own CI, and the main full run at ≤1.2×.

**Restart-when:** the objectui → objectstack repository move is done. The card is then re-read against the merged CI, where the shard-timings refresh may be rebuilt or dropped. Until then, nobody works this card.
